The '''''Dragonfly''-class Imperial drop ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Vrath Xizor]] used one as his personal transport, which he named the [[Razor (Dragonfly-class)|''Razor'']].
